lastChangeSummary: Applied the approved Phase 1/Phase 2 redefinition: Phase 1 is now a small Developer-Chat-focused foundation (exit test = discuss in Developer Chat, convert to Feature/Issue/Milestone/Task/Subtask, save, see it in the Developer UI, reopen with chat/context intact -- no autonomous execution required). The old M-07-5.3 three-worker Foundation Gate and the F-07-2..F-07-6 tool/orchestrator work move to Phase 2. WorkItem is retired as a hierarchy level in favour of Workspace > Project > Subproject > Feature > Task > Subtask, with Milestone as a grouping/delivery link and Issue as a universal attachment. 23 nodes marked Superseded (not deleted), 71 nodes reclassified Phase 1 -> Phase 2, 21 new nodes added (F-07-10 Developer Domain Foundation subtree, F-06-8 Subproject, M-04-3.3 minimal AI Role abstraction, M-12-0.4 Developer UI shell). Recorded as ADR-005. Phase Plan rewritten with the new P1-1..P1-7 / P2-1..P2-10 sequence; old P1-00..P1-07 rows marked Superseded, not deleted.
notes: Prior manifest (generatedAt 2026-08-26T10:30:00+05:30, controlBaseline 1.3) reflected CHG-20260826-002. This manifest reflects CHG-20260826-003, the Phase 1/2 redefinition approved by Durai on 2026-08-26.
No application/source repository content was modified by this change -- it is a governance-workbook-only update. Nexus.Developer code implementation (Phase 1 tracks P1-1..P1-7) begins next.
